changed_entries.title: Herron Todd White – CJA Lee Property Valuers

changes.old: The ACCC has prepared a questionnaire on the Acquisition. Submissions or information in response to the questionnaire should be provided by 2 September 2026 via email to mergers@accc.gov.au with the title Herron Todd White – CJA Property Pty Ltd. Open date 26 Aug 2026 Closing date 2 Sep 2026
changes.new: The period for providing submissions or information in response to the ACCC’s questionnaire has concluded.
